[spoiler=[i][b]E2000 RP[/b] - The Helmsman on Rocky Sea's.[/i]]
[b][i]Hyeangseul, Hyeangseul Metropolitan City Region
Gojong Road, Bonbu Ward
The Palace of the President[/b]
[u]October 12th, 2026[/i][/u]

War as a concept for the [b]Republic of Yeongrang[/b] is one ingrained in national [b]trauma and tragedy.[/b] We remember from the textbooks the numbers of [b]lost men and women[/b] in our wars of liberation, and still we remember the [b]echoes of the revolutions' past[/b]. Millions of sons and daughters, lost for the sake of the [b]revolution and country.[/b] Yet it seems no matter how many wars the world has, [b]there still exists room for more[/b]. As the drums of war seemingly [b]echo closer to midnight[/b], it is in quiet [b]Hyeangseul[/b] where the [b]Helmsman sails the ship of state[/b] again through rocky waters. For the helmsman must guide their ship, even through the [b]harshest of waters[/b], and such was the duty of the state to guide Yeongrang through another crisis once again.

[i]"Madame Seo-Yun, you're still in your office?"[/i] Asked the aide, his gaze towards the bundle of newspapers in the corner. [b]"Thývenian Economy continues to slump!"[/b] printed in bold in Hangul at the front. His eyes then towards the table, a bundle of papers, official documents and reports for the economy. New executive orders, modifications to going plans by the [b]Ministry of Industrial Development and Trade's[/b] five year plans. Globalised economies such as Yeongrang would prove most exceptionally vulnerable towards shakeups in the global supply chains like this, but even thunder hides sunlight in its way. A fact recognized by the President which had spent so long in her office in the leadup of this weeks Parliamentary meeting.

[i]"Rest was simply not in today's bingo cards,"[/i] sighed the President, a shake of her hand, her fingers ran through the black strands of her hair as she grumbled on her chair. [b]Barely in her 40's[/b] at the start of her first term, and the Republic was already [b]shaking at its knee's[/b] with a [b]new crisis[/b] caused by [b]western follies[/b], [i]"We must show our markets to be stronger than that of the wests."[/i] she grumbled. The ink of her pen continuing to scribble her signature on another printed order. [b]New tax breaks[/b] for the corporations, [b]new contracts[/b] for infrastructure projects, [b]new approved meetings[/b] with international investors from the THEP and beyond. Everyone must be [b]courted[/b], everyone must be [b]pleased,[/b] everyone must be [b]pursued,[/b] every [b]inch of capital secured[/b].

[i]"Well, ma'am, at least we aren't experiencing investor flight."[/i] commented the aide, that at least was true. The crisis coinciding with Yeongrang's new [b]proven track record[/b] as a stable [b]source for investment[/b] with high gains has transformed the economy that once focused so much on [b]low-technology manufacturing[/b] such as textiles to that of a industrial giant in northern Amaralo that produces [b]billions in electronics and sophisticated industrial goods every year[/b]. From that of simply [b]Daesun's 'Blue Hat'[/b] to what some describe as the [b]'Sleeping Tiger of the North'[/b]. Yet it would be false to suggest this was all the work of the state; for [b]foreign capital played no small role[/b] in kickstarting the nations boom. [b]Foreign backers and currencies [/b]often intertwined with [b]domestic industrial development[/b] that would see itself exported to markets beyond their home shores. Still, it was only through [b]stability and capability[/b] that brought these investors to our shores. It would be troublesome to let them go now.

[i]"Perhaps that is true,"[/i] muttered the President, her eyes still glued to another report. This time from the [b]Ministry of Foreign Affairs[/b], statements include a rather large i[b]ncrease of travelers on business[/b] and [b]applications for work visa's[/b] from international sources. [b]A small smile[/b] left the corner of her lips, before returning to her usual, [b]unemotional frown[/b]. Her head raised to her aide, as she spoke again [i]"But the ship of the state [b]requires a Helmsman[/b], and unfortunately..."[/i] she said, a half-sarcastic sigh from her lips, "They've got [b]a Helmswoman.[/b]"

-------------------

[b][i]In response to what the Yeongnese Ministry of Foreign Affairs dubs as an increasingly deteriorating international situation with the EDU and THEP; Yeongrang has emphasized in a message to its global partners for both caution and cooperation to achieve a peaceful solution to the ongoing crisis between both bloc's. Whilst also emphasizing Yeongrang's neutrality in ongoing international affairs until it reaches its shores or directly harms Yeongnese interests.

In the meantime, the Yeongnese Ministry of Industrial Development and Trade has released a joint statement with the Ministry of National Planning regarding a series of revisions for the ongoing 10th Five-Year Plan which currently coincides with the Kuoheidang's effort since 2021 to double the economic by 2036. Notably, the Kuoheidang has announced the following;[/b]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ - A reduction of tariff's for the importation of unprocessed natural resources from international sources aimed at diversifying trade partners.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ - Accelerated goals for the integration of automated measures into the functions of government in cooperation with private sector entities.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ - In cooperation with the Ministry of Finance, an increase of loans being issued in foreign currencies towards private sector entities.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ - Targeted investments towards the development of existing industrial infrastructure through the introduction of new industrial robotics.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ - Accelerated integration efforts to synthesize cooperation between computer-based management systems and existing industrial infrastructure 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ - Integration of the Internet of Things (IoT) and new local software and cloud infrastructure into existing industrial infrastructure.

[b]Present efforts are coinciding with a new push towards injecting more financial capital into the Yeongnese economy to stimulate job growth and maximize economic output on a greater level. Whilst closer cooperation between the Ministry of Industrial Development and Trade with Yeongnese megacorporations have also been launched in order to enhance the position of national champions in an increasingly competitive global economy whilst enhancing cooperation with international partners alike to achieve investor confidence in the future of the Yeongnese economy.[/b][/i]
[/spoiler]

[b]Offensive into Häliskirk[/b]
[spoiler]
The month of October had began and brought with it the regular bitterness and frost seen in Gythena during the dusk months. The temperatures had dropped dramatically and snow was beginning to crawl across the landscape, brushing at the land like frosting on a cake. In these conditions, the Gythenan army truly had their chance to shine. Reindeer and snow sleds were brought upon the battlefield as an alternative mode of travel to motorized vehicles, and the use of the reliable Kalashnikov rifle, known for its ability to withstand blasted conditions, made the winter Gythenan army very efficient in the winter months.

The Vespurians and Sanguivallan task forces got to witness these developments first hand as they made their way north. Around 40,000 Gythenan socialist rebels were marching towards the capital city of Häliskirk, armed with significant machinery including armored vehicles and a number of artillery units. Polijamsa was the largest city in all of Gythena and had stored much of the militarys arsenal, which made the swift capture of the city by the socialists all the more impressive and valuable to the leftist war effort.

Ulf de Mayne was a leading figure within the Red Guards, having been a veteran of recent modern conflicts and a respected member within the ranks of the army. Many Gythenan army members ranging from simple privates to respected field marshals had joined up with the Red Guards in the name of the red revolution, inspired by the victories won by the leftist forces. 

The Red Guards arriving at Häliskirk were met with a sad view of the city. Smoke plumes rose high into the sky, while snow began blanketing the streets and buildings within. This was not the same Häliskirk as the one just a year before. Nevertheless, an offensive within the outskirts of the city was launched, utilizing the element of speed and surprise to their advantage. Both Ulf de Mayne and the former Gythenan field Marshalls made superb leaders in modern combat, handling what remained of the Gythenan army with relative ease. The presence of the Red Guards was soon warned about, however, and the situation grew muckier for the Red Guards, as those that fought in the name of the crumbling Commonwealth were making a stand against those who fought in the name of the rights of the worker.
[/spoiler]

[b][u]The[/u] [u]Principality[/u] [u]of[/u] [u]Eneas[/u][/b]
[b][i]An Undue Bath[/i][/b]

Things go as usual within the Principality of Eneas. A woeful year on the northern hemisphere, but here down the more finer lands of the southern hemisphere, it's peaceful, prosperous even. A fine life. A fine nation.

A fine day for 108-year-old alcoholic cigar addict mercenary veteran Valient Mariello Hohenstein-Moselle, Duke of Moselle, and overall long time banned from Court and under seven years of house arrest after an incident involving an old car, an expired driving licence, and a bus of thankfully unharmed but startled tourists, to take a bath.

Not any bath. A very hot bath. With one of those modern folk soaps. He always use soap from when he was born. Because his estate was stocked with it. So he had a, very much nurse aided, bath. And went to bed. Unfortunately, after being the longest reigning duke of his house, and longest lived one, something extraordinary happened.

He died.

Officially, old age. Unofficially that bath had killed all the layer of muck, dirt, germs, and bacteria keeping him basically artificially alive. He was given a state funeral, as it's norm, and then his heir was made Duke of Moselle.

... except there wasn't any. He outlived his sons. And outlived his grandsons. And outlived his great-grandsons. And his brothers. And his nephews. And his grandnephews. And his great -grandnephews. But what about the wome [b]shut[/b] the fvck up.

It's succession crisis time.

Naturally anyone with the surname Moselle or Hohenstein was sent both an email, a text, called up, sent a voice mail, a letter, and one telegraph, to ensure they informed that the Enean Principality would very much like to talk to them about their Duchy's extended warranty.

Unfortunately it was left to a Hochdeutsche secretary to write the memos and then a Montfleurian to transcribe it into the proper language before it got edited and redrafted by a Hydronian that somehow landed a position in the civilian government, before finally being burnt and turned into pait no, just kidding. It was emailed to those kicked out and allegedly still royals in exile.
